overview_description.description: Narrator powers self-service analytics across all the data. It allows anyone to get answers in minutes instead of weeks, using the same data. Narrator helps build a full customer 360 that covers every interaction customers have with the business such as opened emails, paid invoices, new support tickets, etc., which provides the foundation for a comprehensive self-service experience for the company. Anyone can answer quick questions and self-serve requests across all the data without needing SQL, and then integrate that data with existing tools such as spreadsheets, BI, and SaaS tools like email providers.
